title: Please give a review on my water implementation in my game engine.
author: VulkanVX
selftext:
Hello there,

Not that long ago I finished the visuals behind the water, and I really wanted to ask an opinion from random people, since I don't have friends.

Would be interesting to hear your opinion on the visuals, your criticism.

Since I use AI for a lot of research and coding, I decided to post it here, haha.

It is a game engine in Vulkan I am currently developing for the past year. I use a lot of AI, and different AI but mainly Claude Opus 5.5. 

Although a lot of the engine boilerplate was initially build with early ChatGPT 5 models (such as 5.3, 5.5) I find that Opus 5.5 is a lot better at researching difficult and niche optimization choices. 

By the way, this is currently running on an 4GB VRAM Nvidia GPU. I've spent last 6 months optimizing every single aspect of the engine.
